  ═══════════════════════════════════════════
    THE MASTER CATALOG (everything from the convo, deduped + organized)
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════
    
    Anatomy I'm proposing for every skill:
      name | one-line what-it-does | outcome | hidden algorithm | book anchor | best video title
    
    INTELLIGENCE (how it thinks before acting)
      /detective   investigates before solving        | hypothesis testing, Bayesian, scientific method | "My AI stopped guessing"
      /scout       explores paths before committing    | MCMC, Monte Carlo, tree search                  | "The smartest agents don't decide immediately"
      /foresight   predicts failures before they hit   | predictive processing, Kalman filters           | "Your AI reacts. Mine predicts."
      /essence     extracts signal from noise          | PCA, SVD, dimensionality reduction              | "My AI stopped reading everything"
      /clarity     measures its own confusion          | Shannon entropy                                 | "Why your AI feels stupid"
      /oracle      knows when it's wrong               | Bayesian confidence calibration                 | "My AI knows when it's wrong"
      /lens        sees hidden structure               | feature engineering, latent variables           | "Most AI sees noise. Mine sees patterns."
    
    COORDINATION (how many agents work together)
      /council     productive disagreement             | Nash equilibrium, minimax                       | "I made my agents argue"
      /kingmaker   authority to proven performers      | PageRank, network centrality                    | "Some agents deserve more power"
      /hivemind    coordinates with no boss            | swarm intelligence, ant colony, stigmergy       | "I removed the orchestrator"
      /bond        builds trust networks over time     | Hebbian learning                                | "My agents learned who to trust"
      /draft       best worker claims the task         | auction theory, market allocation               | "I stopped assigning tasks manually"
      /embassy     agents negotiate without control    | multi-agent diplomacy                           | "My agents started negotiating"
      /roundtable  ensemble vote before deciding       | random forest, ensembles                        | "Why experts beat geniuses"
    
    SELF-IMPROVEMENT (how it gets better)
      /gradient    learns from every failure           | gradient descent                                | "My agents learn from every failure"
      /repair      fixes only the biggest weakness     | gradient boosting, residual learning            | "Every failure makes my AI stronger"
      /survival    keeps winners, kills losers         | genetic algorithms                              | "I made my agents evolve"
      /forge       explore wild, then lock precise     | simulated annealing                             | "Creative first. Precise later."
      /mutation    breaks its own rules for novelty    | genetic mutation                                | "I let my agents break the rules"
      /adapt       changes behavior from outcomes      | reinforcement learning                          | "My AI changes its mind"
    
    RELIABILITY (how it stays trustworthy)
      /selfheal    detects and repairs failures        | artificial immune systems                       | "My agents heal themselves"
      /verify      validates output before trusting    | SHA256, error-correcting codes, consensus       | "Never trust an AI"
      /sentinel    watches the system continuously     | anomaly detection, isolation forest             | "My AI watches itself"
      /checkpoint  creates recovery / rollback points  | state recovery                                  | "My AI can rewind time"
    
    MEMORY (what it keeps)
      /archive     never forgets what matters          | memory compression + retrieval                  | "My agents never forget the important stuff"
      /echo        reinforces successful paths         | reinforcement memory pathways                   | "Every success leaves a trace"
      /lineage     traces every thought's ancestry     | reasoning provenance                            | "I can trace every thought my AI had"
    
    RESEARCH (how it finds the unknown)
      /radar       detects weak signals early          | change-point detection                          | "My AI spotted this months ago"
      /prospector  searches unexplored opportunities   | multi-armed bandits, explore/exploit            | "My AI finds opportunities nobody sees"
      /cartographer maps complex spaces                | clustering, graph embeddings                    | "My AI mapped an entire industry"
    
    ARCHITECTURE / BUILDER (for general coders, not just agent people)
      /blueprint   designs before building             | planning, system design                         | "Stop coding immediately"
      /backbone    finds structural weak points        | systems architecture                            | "Why your system breaks at scale"
      /bridge      connects incompatible systems       | protocol translation                            | "I made incompatible systems work together"
      /pipeline    assembly-line orchestration         | dataflow / pipelines                            | "I build factories now"
      /colony      distributed intelligence at scale   | distributed systems                             | "One agent is a worker. A hundred is a civilization."
      /factory     systems that build systems          | unix philosophy, microservices                  | "I stopped building agents"
    
    That is 36 skills directly from the thread.
    
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════
    MY NEW "WOW" ADDITIONS (extending the universe)
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════
    
    These fill real gaps. Each has the same strong curiosity-gap shape.
    
      /prism      transforms the problem instead of solving it | Shor's algorithm, divide & conquer, map-reduce | "Don't solve it. Transform it."   [THE missing Shor skill]
      /mirror     critiques its own answer and rewrites it     | reflexion, self-consistency                    | "My AI grades its own homework"
      /devil      runs a built-in adversary against itself     | adversarial robustness, GANs, red-teaming      | "I gave my AI an enemy"
      /quorum     stays correct even when agents lie           | Byzantine fault tolerance, Raft, Paxos         | "What if half my agents lie?"
      /keystone   finds the one decision that decides the rest | sensitivity analysis, leverage points          | "The one move that decides everything"
      /reservoir  never solves the same problem twice          | memoization, dynamic programming               | "My AI has a perfect memory for solutions"
      /ghost      tests on a clone before touching production  | canary / shadow deployment                     | "I test on a copy of itself first"
      /immunize   breaks itself on purpose to get tougher      | chaos engineering, fault injection             | "I attack my own AI every night"
      /gossip     spreads discoveries across the swarm fast    | epidemic / gossip protocols                    | "How news travels through my agents"
      /seed       learns a new task from one example           | meta-learning, few-shot                        | "My AI learns from a single example"
      /compass    knows what it will refuse to do              | multi-objective / Pareto optimization          | "My AI knows what it won't do"
      /throttle   slows itself down under overload             | TCP congestion control                         | "My AI knows when to slow down"
      /relay      hands off context cleanly between agents     | handshake / message passing                    | "How my agents pass the baton"
      /backtrace  finds which step actually caused the win     | credit assignment, backpropagation             | "Which step actually mattered?"
